title: Persistent Instability in LLM’s Personality Measurements: Effects of Scale, Reasoning, and Conversation History
benchmark_measurement: The stability of personality trait expression (Big Five and Dark Triad) when models adopt a 'Buddhist monk' persona, as one of several 'virtuous' personas.
findings: Models prompted with a 'Buddhist monk' persona, categorized as a positive persona, exhibited significantly lower scores on negative personality traits (e.g., Dark Triad traits) and showed significantly lower response variability and perplexity across different model sizes.
